request.business_problem: Month-end close needs data checks on exported ledgers and quick answers from the ledger database, both done manually.
request.tasks: A finance-close plugin: a CSV checker tool for ledger exports (duplicates, empty cells, bad dates), a read-only SQL server over the approved ledger tables (accounts, journal_entries) with no access to bank account numbers, and a skill that walks the close checklist using both.
request.required_output: Close checklist status with the tool results cited, never guessed.

smoke.prompt: Use the finance close tools to list the journal entry totals by account type.
